welcome:
Welcome to the systemd CLI Playground.
Simulating Ubuntu 22.04 LTS with nginx, node-app, postgresql, and redis services.
Type commands to explore service management and system diagnostics.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

scenarios.title: Create and Debug a Custom Service

steps.instruction: First, check what unit files exist for our node application.
The service file doesn't exist yet. Let's create it. After writing /etc/systemd/system/node-app.service, reload the daemon to pick up the new file.
Now enable the service so it starts on boot.
The service failed to start. Check its status to see what went wrong.
Status shows an exit code error. Check the full journal logs for the service.
The logs show a missing environment file. After fixing /etc/default/node-app, restart the service.
Verify the service is now running and healthy.
The server just rebooted. Check how long the boot took.
Something slowed boot down. Find which services took the longest.
PostgreSQL is slow. Check the critical chain to see what blocked on it.
Now list all failed services on the system.
The backup.timer unit failed. Check its dependencies.
Check all active timers to understand the schedule.
The backup timer is inactive. Re-enable and start it.
Verify the timer is now scheduled by checking timers again.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  systemctl status [unit]        — Show service status
  systemctl start [unit]         — Start a service
  systemctl stop [unit]          — Stop a service
  systemctl restart [unit]       — Restart a service
  systemctl enable [unit]        — Enable at boot
  systemctl disable [unit]       — Disable at boot
  systemctl daemon-reload        — Reload unit files
  systemctl list-units           — List active units
  systemctl list-unit-files      — List all unit files
  systemctl list-units --failed  — Show failed units
  systemctl list-timers          — Show active timers
  systemctl list-dependencies    — Show unit dependencies
  systemctl mask/unmask [unit]   — Prevent/allow starting
  systemctl cat [unit]           — Show unit file contents
  systemctl show [unit]          — Show unit properties
  systemctl edit [unit]          — Edit unit overrides
  systemctl is-active [unit]     — Check if active
  systemctl is-enabled [unit]    — Check if enabled
  journalctl -u [unit]           — Logs for a service
  journalctl -f                  — Follow live logs
  journalctl -p err              — Show only errors
  journalctl --since/--until     — Filter by time
  journalctl --disk-usage        — Journal disk usage
  journalctl --list-boots        — List boot records
  systemd-analyze                — Boot time summary
  systemd-analyze blame          — Slowest units at boot
  systemd-analyze critical-chain — Boot critical path
  hostnamectl                    — Hostname info
  timedatectl                    — Time/date info
  loginctl                       — Session info
  systemd-cgls                   — Control group tree
  systemd-cgtop                  — Control group resource usage

  scenario                       — Start a guided lab
  clear                          — Clear the terminal
  help                           — Show this help

commands.systemctl cat nginx.service:
# /lib/systemd/system/nginx.service
[Unit]
Description=A high performance web server and reverse proxy
Documentation=man:nginx(8)
After=network-online.target remote-fs.target nss-lookup.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=forking
PIDFile=/run/nginx.pid
ExecStartPre=/usr/sbin/nginx -t -q -g 'daemon on; master_process on;'
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/nginx -g 'daemon on; master_process on;'
ExecReload=/bin/kill -s HUP $MAINPID
ExecStop=/bin/kill -s QUIT $MAINPID
PrivateTmp=true
LimitNOFILE=65536
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

commands.systemctl cat node-app.service:
# /etc/systemd/system/node-app.service
[Unit]
Description=Node.js Production Application
Documentation=https://internal.wiki/node-app
After=network-online.target postgresql.service redis-server.service
Wants=network-online.target
Requires=postgresql.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=nodeapp
Group=nodeapp
WorkingDirectory=/opt/node-app
EnvironmentFile=/etc/default/node-app
ExecStart=/usr/bin/node /opt/node-app/server.js
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10s
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
SyslogIdentifier=node-app
LimitNOFILE=65536

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
